payload.name: Constructable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Break ground on a new way to manage construction. Constructable for ChatGPT turns project data into a conversation — ask what's open, what's overdue,  or what happened in the field yesterday, and get a straight answer in seconds. Connect your Constructable account to pull project status, RFIs, submittals, and daily reports straight from chat, no digging required.
payload.longDescription: 开启建筑管理的新方式。Constructable for ChatGPT 将项目数据转化为对话——询问有哪些未完成事项、哪些事项已逾期，或昨天现场发生了什么，几秒钟内就能得到直接答案。连接 Constructable 账户后，即可直接在聊天中获取项目状态、RFI、报审文件和每日报告，无需费力查找。

payload.name: Weft
payload.description: 你的AI管理你的任务看板
payload.summaryOriginal: Your AI runs your task board
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Weft is a Scrumban task manager: a kanban board for flow, sprints for focus, no standups or ceremonies. It's built for solo founders, indie makers, and small startup teams who ship without a project manager.

 Once your Weft account is connected, you can manage your board in a conversation:
• Ask "what's on my board?" to get a summary of your columns and active sprint
• Search tasks by keyword across the whole board
• Add new tasks to the backlog and update their details
• Move work across Backlog, Todo, Doing, and Done
• Plan a sprint, start it, and mark it complete — without leaving the chat

Your board stays in sync with Weft on web, desktop, and mobile.
payload.longDescription:
Weft是一款Scrumban任务管理工具：以看板管理流程，用冲刺保持专注，无需站立会议或仪式。
专为独立创始人、个人开发者和无项目经理的小型创业团队打造，助力他们高效交付产品。

账户连接成功后，你可以在聊天中管理看板：
• 输入「我的看板有什么？」获取列状态和当前冲刺概览
• 全看板任务关键词搜索
• 将新任务加入待办列表并编辑详情
• 在待办列表、待做、进行中、已完成之间拖动任务
• 在聊天内完成冲刺规划、启动与完成操作

你的看板内容会同步更新于Weft的网页端、桌面端和移动端。

payload.name: AnyConversion- Imperial/Metric
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Unit Converter – Fast & Accurate Conversion Calculator

Convert units instantly with AnyConversion, the simple and powerful conversion app for everyday use, travel, education, engineering, and professional work.

Easily convert between hundreds of units across multiple categories, including length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, pressure, energy, data storage, and more. Whether you need to convert pounds to kilograms, miles to kilometers, Celsius to Fahrenheit, or gigabytes to megabytes, Unit Converter delivers accurate results in real time.

Features

• Convert units across 9 categories
• Length, weight, temperature, volume, area, speed, time, and more
• Engineering and scientific unit conversions
• Metric and imperial unit support
• Instant calculations as you type
• Clean, easy-to-use interface
• Fast and accurate conversion results
• Works offline – no internet required
• Save time with favorite conversions
• Lightweight and optimized for all devices

Perfect for students, travelers, engineers, builders, scientists, professionals, and anyone who needs quick and reliable unit conversions on the go.

Download AnyConversion today and get all your conversion tools in one convenient app.
payload.longDescription:
单位换算器——快速准确的换算计算器

使用AnyConversion即时换算单位，这款简单而强大的换算应用适用于日常生活、旅行、教育、工程和专业工作。

轻松换算多个类别中的数百种单位，包括长度、重量、温度、面积、体积、速度、压力、能量、数据存储等。无论是将磅换算为千克、英里换算为千米、摄氏度换算为华氏度，还是吉字节换算为兆字节，Unit Converter都能实时提供准确结果。

功能

• 跨9个类别换算单位
• 长度、重量、温度、体积、面积、速度、时间等
• 工程和科学单位换算
• 支持公制与英制单位
• 输入时即时计算
• 整洁易用的界面
• 快速准确的换算结果
• 支持离线使用，无需互联网
• 收藏常用换算，节省时间
• 轻量化，并针对所有设备优化

非常适合学生、旅行者、工程师、建筑工人、科学家、专业人士，以及任何需要随时进行快速可靠单位换算的人。

立即下载AnyConversion，在一个便捷应用中获得所有换算工具。

payload.name: Mosaiq Labs
payload.description: 你所在公司的 AI 大脑
payload.summaryOriginal: The AI brain of your firm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Starting with core documents - IC memos, DDQs, Proposals - encode your expertise into custom AI agents that power your workflows
payload.longDescription: 从核心文件开始——投资委员会（IC）备忘录、DDQ 尽职调查问卷、提案——将你的专业知识编码为定制 AI 智能体，为工作流提供支持。

payload.name: xpost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn a conversation into published social posts.

Tell xpost what you want to post, where and when. It creates the post for each social network and sends it to your approval queue — nothing is published until you approve it.

Publish to X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest. Brand guardrails check your content before it’s queued, and every published post comes with a receipt linking directly to the live version.

You can also ask how your posts performed, what worked best and when your audience is most active.

Connect your xpost account and start asking. Your first post is free.
payload.longDescription:
将对话转化为已发布的社交媒体帖子。

告诉xpost您想发布的内容、发布时间和平台。
它会为每个社交网络创建帖子并发送至您的审批队列——在您批准之前，不会发布任何内容。

支持发布至X、Instagram、LinkedIn、TikTok、YouTube、Facebook、Threads、Bluesky和Pinterest。
品牌规范会在内容入队前进行检查，每篇已发布帖子都包含直接链接到实时版本的收据。

您还可以了解帖子的表现情况、哪些内容效果最佳，以及受众最活跃的时间。

连接您的xpost账户并开始使用。
您的第一篇帖子免费。

payload.name: iLovePDF
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with PDFs directly in chat. Upload a file to compress, merge, split, or convert it (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or images). You can also protect files by adding watermarks, organize them with page numbers, and extract text from scanned documents using OCR. Designed for everyday document tasks, iLovePDF helps you manage files quickly and securely.
payload.longDescription: 直接在聊天中处理 PDF。上传文件即可压缩、合并、拆分或转换为 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint 或图像。你还可以添加水印保护文件、添加页码整理文档，并使用 OCR 从扫描文档中提取文字。iLovePDF 专为日常文档任务设计，帮助你快速、安全地管理文件。

payload.name: RaidRunner
payload.description: 管理 RaidRunner 接力活动时段
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RaidRunner helps Twitch streamers run and join raid trains — back-to-back stream relay events. From ChatGPT you can see the events you perform in or organize, your upcoming claimed slots, and full event lineups; discover public events to join; and claim, release, or waitlist slots and manage slot-trade requests. Everything is scoped to your own connected RaidRunner account.
payload.longDescription: RaidRunner 可帮助 Twitch 主播组织和参与 raid train（连续接力直播活动）。通过 ChatGPT，你可以查看自己参与或组织的活动、即将开始的已认领时段和完整活动阵容；发现并加入公开活动；认领、释放或候补时段，并管理时段交换请求。所有内容都仅限于你本人已连接的 RaidRunner 账户。

payload.name: Concept Workspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Concept Workspace helps users search, read, create, update, import, and delete shared workspace files and skills through ChatGPT, then discover and run brokered connector tools without exposing provider credentials locally.
payload.longDescription: Concept Workspace 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索、阅读、创建、更新、导入和删除共享工作区文件及技能，随后发现并运行由代理中介的连接器工具，同时无需在本地暴露服务提供商凭据。

payload.name: SocialHub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Transform your ideas into social media posts and organised project boards.

With this app you can turn the ideas and media you generated through ChatGPT into social media drafts or even scheduled posts in the SocialHub Content Planner. Additionally, you can get channel suggestions for the content based on your connected platforms in SocialHub.

If you use the Idea Board, you can also use this app to draft cards or build complete boards with structured columns and cards based on your current discussion/prompt.
payload.longDescription:
将想法转化为社交媒体帖子和整理有序的项目看板。

借助此应用，你可以把通过 ChatGPT 生成的想法和媒体内容转换为社交媒体草稿，甚至转换为 SocialHub Content Planner 中已排期的帖子。此外，应用还可以根据你在 SocialHub 中连接的平台，为内容推荐发布渠道。

如果你使用 Idea Board，也可以用此应用起草卡片，或根据当前讨论/提示构建带有结构化列和卡片的完整看板。

payload.name: todo mate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your to-do list with todo mate.
- Retrieve tasks for a specific date range
- Mark tasks as completed
- Add new tasks
- Set time-based notifications for tasks
- Fetch category lists
payload.longDescription:
使用 todo mate 管理待办事项列表。
- 获取指定日期范围内的任务
- 将任务标记为已完成
- 添加新任务
- 为任务设置基于时间的通知
- 获取类别列表

payload.name: Consult with Roy
payload.description: 与 Roy 的顾问代理沟通
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Consult with Roy is the Apps SDK app for ROY — Technology Consultation. It explains Roy's portfolio and offerings, shows case studies in inline ChatGPT cards, captures your goal, answers with Roy's curated concierge guidance, and escalates finance, legal, pricing, contracts, and low-confidence matters to Roy personally. Skills cover intake, discovery, showcase, advisory answers, meeting proposals, recall, and human handoff. Identity is verified by email and engagement records stay in Roy's workspace.
payload.longDescription: Consult with Roy 是 ROY — Technology Consultation 的 Apps SDK 应用。它介绍 Roy 的产品组合和服务，在 ChatGPT 卡片中展示案例研究，了解您的目标，以 Roy 精选的顾问指导回答，并将财务、法律、价格、合同和低置信度事项升级给 Roy 本人。功能涵盖信息收集、探索、展示、咨询回答、会议提议、召回和人工转接。通过电子邮件验证身份，互动记录保存在 Roy 的工作区。

payload.name: the brand id
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: the brand id lets authenticated users connect their live brand profile to ChatGPT. The plugin returns read-only brand context, copy guidance, social guidance, visual guidance, and asset brief guidance from the user's connected brand data.
payload.longDescription: the brand id 允许已通过身份验证的用户将实时品牌档案连接到 ChatGPT。该插件会根据用户已连接的品牌数据，返回只读的品牌背景信息、文案指导、社交媒体指导、视觉指导和素材简报指导。

payload.name: Gumnut Photos
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gumnut Photos helps users search and browse their private photo libraries, inspect image contents, organize assets into albums and people, update metadata, and safely manage uploads and trash through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Gumnut Photos 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 搜索和浏览私人照片库、查看图片内容、按相册和人物整理素材、更新元数据，并安全管理上传内容和回收站。

payload.name: Markup AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Markup AI reviews drafts against an organization's configured quality checks in a single call: brand voice drift, unapproved terminology, style-guide violations, hard-to-read sentences, AI-sounding phrasing, unsupported or risky claims, missing sourcing, and AI-search readiness. Users share content in ChatGPT, optionally state what they are trying to achieve, and get back which checks ran, any configuration warnings, and the flagged issues with locations, explanations, and suggested corrections. Teams can also run an explicit, named set of checks with a chosen persona, brand voice profile, style guide, or content profile, and list the checks and configurations available to their organization.
payload.longDescription: Markup AI 会通过一次调用，根据组织配置的质量检查审阅草稿：品牌语气偏差、未批准术语、风格指南违规、难读句子、听起来像 AI 的表达、缺乏依据或有风险的主张、来源缺失以及 AI 搜索适配度。用户可在 ChatGPT 中分享内容，并可选填目标；随后会收到已运行的检查项目、配置警告，以及包含位置、说明和修改建议的问题列表。团队还可以指定检查名称，选择角色、品牌语气档案、风格指南或内容档案，运行明确的一组检查，并查看组织可用的检查及配置。

payload.name: FeedBoss
payload.description: 起草并评估 LinkedIn 帖子
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FeedBoss connects your assistant to your LinkedIn content workspace. It drafts posts in your saved voice grounded in your own knowledge base, scores a draft against a reader-reaction quality check before anything is published, saves drafts you can edit, and schedules approved drafts to publish to LinkedIn at a time you confirm each time. It also reports analytics, weekly posting-consistency streaks, and a refreshed wall of high-performing posts for inspiration.
payload.longDescription: FeedBoss 将助手连接到你的 LinkedIn 内容工作区。它会依据你保存的表达风格和自己的知识库起草帖子，并在发布前按读者反应质量标准为草稿评分。你可以保存并编辑草稿，也可以安排已批准的草稿在指定时间发布到 LinkedIn；每次发布都需由你确认。它还会提供分析数据、每周持续发帖连胜记录，以及更新后的高表现帖子墙，供你获取灵感。

payload.name: Free Marathi Biodata Maker
payload.description: 创建马拉地语婚介资料
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create a marriage biodata (lagna biodata) in Marathi or English, directly in chat. Share a few details — name, education, family background, horoscope — and get back a polished, ready-to-share PDF within seconds.

Choose from 11 traditional templates, or generate several at once to compare side by side. No sign-up or login required, and it's completely free — the same biodata maker used on MarathiVivah.co.in, a free matrimony platform for Maharashtra's Marathi-speaking families.
payload.longDescription:
直接在聊天中用马拉地语或英语创建婚姻介绍资料（lagna biodata）。提供姓名、教育背景、家庭情况和星盘等基本信息，几秒钟内即可获得精美、可直接分享的 PDF。

可从 11 种传统模板中选择，也可以一次生成多个模板并排比较。无需注册或登录，完全免费——使用的正是 MarathiVivah.co.in 提供的同款资料生成器；该网站是面向马哈拉施特拉邦马拉地语家庭的免费婚介平台。

payload.name: CopyCharm
payload.description: 访问你的 CopyCharm 上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CopyCharm is a context workbench for saving and reusing prompts, notes, favorite clips, and curated working context.

With this ChatGPT integration, existing CopyCharm users can access selected CopyCharm items directly within ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying and pasting the same background information, project notes, or templates into each chat, users can ask ChatGPT to find and retrieve the exact context they need.

This integration only accesses items that have been intentionally made available for AI Access in CopyCharm. It does not provide ChatGPT with access to a user's broader workspace or general clipboard history.
payload.longDescription:
CopyCharm 是用于保存和重用提示词、笔记、收藏片段及精选工作上下文的工作台。

通过此 ChatGPT 集成，现有 CopyCharm 用户可直接在 ChatGPT 中访问选定的 CopyCharm 条目。无需在每次聊天中手动复制粘贴相同的背景信息、项目笔记或模板，用户可以让 ChatGPT 查找并调取所需的准确上下文。

此集成只访问你在 CopyCharm 中主动设为可供 AI 访问的条目。它不会让 ChatGPT 访问用户更广泛的工作区或通用剪贴板历史。

payload.name: Breeze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Breeze helps teams find project information, manage cards and checklists, collaborate through comments and project discussions, track time and estimates, and safely update or remove workspace data through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Breeze 帮助团队查找项目信息、管理卡片和清单、通过评论和项目讨论进行协作、跟踪工时和预估，并通过 ChatGPT 安全更新或移除工作区数据。

payload.name: Rezi Resume Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Rezi account to list and read resumes, create new resumes, update resume content, and search job listings. Tailor a resume for a specific role, revise individual sections, or build a new resume from your background. Changes are saved directly to your Rezi account.
payload.longDescription: 连接你的 Rezi 账户，即可列出和阅读简历、创建新简历、更新简历内容并搜索职位列表。针对特定职位定制简历、修改单独章节，或根据你的经历创建新简历。所有更改都会直接保存到你的 Rezi 账户。

payload.name: Olie Flow AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Olie Flow AI lets users manage their Olie workspace from ChatGPT: search and list projects, check project status and history, browse funnels and their steps, read and add project content, track funnel and step metrics, move projects between steps, and create, edit, or clone projects.
payload.longDescription: Olie Flow AI 让用户可以在 ChatGPT 中管理 Olie 工作区：搜索和列出项目、查看项目状态与历史记录、浏览漏斗及其步骤、读取和添加项目内容、跟踪漏斗与步骤指标、在步骤间移动项目，以及创建、编辑或克隆项目。

payload.name: Promptbanken
payload.description: 查找并使用提示词模板
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

The published connector is open, read-only, and requires no account or sign-in. It receives only the parameters its tools define: a search term, a role word, filters, and the id or slug of a catalog entry. Nothing else from the conversation reaches the server, and the connector publishes no write tools, so it cannot store anything. Search terms are never stored — only the length of a query is counted in anonymous usage statistics.
payload.longDescription:
Promptbanken 是面向市政机构、学校、企业、协会和个人的开放、精选提示词模板库。可搜索任务、完整获取模板并逐步使用提示词包。连接器开放且只读，无需账户或登录；只接收工具定义的搜索词、角色词、筛选器及目录条目的

ID 或 slug，不会接收对话中的其他内容，也没有写入工具，因此不能存储、修改、发布或删除任何内容。该功能为只读。需要满足相关要求。

payload.name: Slidely
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slidely helps users create, import, review, and edit PowerPoint presentations from ChatGPT. Users can start a new deck or import an existing .pptx, choose a design system, have Slidely draft and render slides, review the proposed slides, and add the approved ones to their presentation.
payload.longDescription: Slidely 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 创建、导入、审阅和编辑 PowerPoint 演示文稿。用户可以新建演示文稿或导入现有 .pptx、选择设计系统、让 Slidely 起草并渲染幻灯片、审阅提议的幻灯片，并将获批的幻灯片加入演示文稿。

payload.name: NivaDesk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NivaDesk helps custom-order studios manage orders, customers, personal notes, tasks, schedules and financial summaries from ChatGPT. After connecting a NivaDesk workspace, users can search orders, view dashboard summaries, check permitted financial information, create personal notes and update order statuses.

It is designed for small teams and studios that work on made-to-order projects, including bespoke art, handmade products, repairs, photography, tailoring, jewellery and other client-based workflows.
payload.longDescription:
NivaDesk 帮助定制订单工作室通过 ChatGPT 管理订单、客户、私人笔记、任务、日程和财务摘要。连接 NivaDesk 工作区后，用户可以搜索订单、查看仪表板摘要、检查获准查看的财务信息、创建私人笔记并更新订单状态。

它适用于承接定制项目的小团队和工作室，包括定制艺术品、手工制品、维修、摄影、裁缝、珠宝及其他以客户为中心的工作流程。

payload.name: F-AI Contract Template Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finds links to legal document templates that match the selected filters. Covers contracts, agreements, policies, resolutions, letters, and other legal documents. 

This plugin is intended for general informational purposes and does not provide legal advice. Its developer is not a law firm, and using the plugin does not establish an attorney-client relationship. AI-generated results may contain inaccurate or outdated information. Consult a qualified legal professional before relying on or using any template.
payload.longDescription:
根据所选筛选条件查找匹配的法律文档模板链接。涵盖合同、协议、政策、决议、信函及其他法律文档。

此插件仅供一般信息参考，不提供法律建议。其开发者不是律师事务所，使用本插件不会建立律师与客户关系。AI 生成的结果可能包含不准确或过时的信息。依赖或使用任何模板前，请咨询合格的法律专业人士。

payload.name: DocHub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DocHub for ChatGPT helps you handle document work — from creation to sign requests — without switching tools. Use natural language to create ready-to-use PDFs and refine them. Fill form fields, prepare and send sign requests, and track progress — all in one conversation.

No paid DocHub subscription is required to get started — ideal for individuals and teams looking for a simpler way to get documents done.
payload.longDescription:
DocHub for ChatGPT 帮助你处理文档工作，从创建到签署请求，无需切换工具。使用自然语言创建可直接使用的 PDF 并对其进行完善。填写表单字段、准备并发送签署请求、跟踪进度——全部在同一段对话中完成。

开始使用无需订阅 DocHub 付费套餐，非常适合希望更轻松处理文档的个人和团队。

payload.name: CodeWords
payload.description: 构建智能体和自动化流程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CodeWords lets you build, deploy, and run automation workflows and websites directly from conversation. Describe what you want to automate or build, and CodeWords handles the rest - writing the code, connecting your services, deploying to the cloud, and scheduling runs. Build full-stack web apps deployed to your own URL, or backend automations that connect to Slack, Gmail, Notion, and hundreds of other services and integrations. When something breaks, pull up the logs and fix it right from the chat.
payload.longDescription: CodeWords 让你直接通过对话构建、部署并运行自动化工作流和网站。描述你想要自动化或构建的内容，CodeWords 会处理其余工作——编写代码、连接服务、部署到云端并安排运行。你可以构建部署在自有 URL 上的全栈 Web 应用，也可以构建连接 Slack、Gmail、Notion 及数百种其他服务和集成的后端自动化流程。出现故障时，可直接在聊天中调出日志并修复。

payload.name: Partoska
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ever spent hours chasing down photos scattered across chat groups, email threads, and random cloud folders after a party? Partoska fixes that.

Create an event, share a link or QR code, and watch the photos roll in—from everyone, in one place, in full quality.

Perfect for weddings, birthday parties, team events, family reunions, corporate gatherings, sports matches, camps, and anywhere people take photos worth keeping.
payload.longDescription:
是否曾经花数小时在聊天群组、邮件线程和随机云文件夹中四处寻找派对后的照片？Partoska为您解决这一难题。

创建活动，分享链接或二维码，即可实时接收来自所有人的照片，全部集中展示，画质完整。

适用于婚礼、生日派对、团队活动、家庭聚会、公司聚会、体育赛事、夏令营以及所有需要保存珍贵照片的场合。

payload.name: F-AI: Contract Review
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Reviews a supplied contract for potential internal conflicts, ambiguity, missing terms, commercial or operational risks, and carefully grounded potential legal issues. The read-only interface connects each finding to the relevant contract language and lets you choose which findings to discuss. This plugin provides issue spotting and general information, not legal advice or recommendations to accept, reject, sign, or amend a contract. Its developer is not a law firm, and use does not establish an attorney-client relationship.
payload.longDescription: 检查所提供合同中可能存在的内部冲突、歧义、缺失条款、商业或运营风险，以及有合同依据的潜在法律问题。只读界面会将每项发现关联到合同中的相关措辞，并允许你选择要讨论的发现。本插件提供问题识别和一般信息，不提供法律建议，也不建议接受、拒绝、签署或修改合同。其开发者不是律师事务所，使用本插件不会建立律师与客户关系。

payload.name: PingPrompt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PingPrompt helps users create, search, organize, and safely edit reusable prompt artifacts from ChatGPT. The app connects ChatGPT to the user's PingPrompt workspace so prompts can be saved into projects, opened in the PingPrompt editor, versioned from the first save, and updated through validated patches that refuse missing or ambiguous edits.
payload.longDescription: PingPrompt 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中创建、搜索、整理并安全编辑可重复使用的提示词内容。此应用将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 PingPrompt 工作区，使提示词可以保存到项目、在 PingPrompt 编辑器中打开、从首次保存起进行版本管理，并通过经过验证的补丁进行更新；若找不到要修改的内容或匹配不明确，补丁会拒绝执行。

payload.name: Delivery Report Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract structured information from AI development delivery reports, including summaries, changed files, implementation items, fixes, tests, and notes. This app helps users quickly organize delivery details from engineering reports. It only analyzes provided text and does not modify code, access external systems, or perform deployment actions.
payload.longDescription: 从 AI 开发交付报告中提取结构化信息，包括摘要、变更文件、实现事项、修复、测试和备注。此应用帮助用户快速整理工程报告中的交付详情。它只分析用户提供的文本，不会修改代码、访问外部系统或执行部署操作。

payload.name: Keypup
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keypup is the engineering analytics platform allowing software development teams to federate data from Git (e.g., GitHub) and project management (e.g., Jira) platforms to gain visibility into their development process.

With the Keypup app in ChatGPT, you can ask questions about your engineering and product deliveries in plain language and generate fully designed reports. ChatGPT will automatically build analytical queries and leverage the Keypup data model to obtain information on volumes, cycle times, segmentation, etc.
payload.longDescription:
Keypup 是一个工程分析平台，帮助软件开发团队整合 Git（例如 GitHub）和项目管理（例如 Jira）平台的数据，以了解开发流程。

使用 ChatGPT 中的 Keypup 应用，你可以用自然语言询问工程和产品交付情况，并生成完整设计的报告。ChatGPT 会自动构建分析查询，并利用 Keypup 数据模型获取数量、周期时长、分组等信息。

payload.name: Runa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Runa brings your authorized meeting knowledge into ChatGPT. Search meeting summaries and approved folder documents, retrieve recent or topic-matched meetings, review decisions and key takeaways, list open action items, and prepare for upcoming meetings using Runa’s latest synchronized calendar context.

Runa is read-only in ChatGPT. It cannot edit meetings, complete action items, or send messages. Results are limited by the connected user’s Runa access, workspace external-AI policy, and Runa’s public connector safety controls. A Runa account is required. Upcoming meeting info reflects Runa’s latest desktop sync and may not be live.
payload.longDescription:
Runa 将你获授权访问的会议知识带入 ChatGPT。搜索会议摘要和已批准的文件夹文档，检索近期会议或主题匹配的会议，查看决策和要点，列出未完成的行动事项，并根据 Runa 最新同步的日历背景准备即将举行的会议。

Runa 在 ChatGPT 中为只读。它无法编辑会议、完成行动事项或发送消息。结果受已连接用户的 Runa 访问权限、工作区外部 AI 政策以及 Runa 公共连接器安全控制的限制。需要 Runa 账户。即将举行的会议信息反映 Runa 最近一次桌面同步，可能不是实时数据。

payload.name: PracticPro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PracticPro is the CRM and operations platform contractors and service businesses use to run their full workflow: clients and leads, estimates, contracts with electronic signatures, invoices and payments, phone calls, SMS, email, scheduling, and custom reports. Inside ChatGPT, every part of that workflow runs in plain English. Examples: "send the Carmichael estimate for signature", "record a $5,000 deposit from Rachel Kim", "text Tony Vasquez to confirm tomorrow's install", "draft a $4,200 invoice for the kitchen demo", or "show jobs with unpaid balances over $10K". Every action executes against your live PracticPro account with your existing permissions.
payload.longDescription: PracticPro 是承包商和服务企业用于管理完整工作流的 CRM 与运营平台，涵盖客户和潜客、报价、电子签名合同、发票和付款、电话、短信、电子邮件、排程及自定义报告。在 ChatGPT 中，整个工作流都可用自然语言运行，例如发送报价供签署、记录 5,000 美元定金、短信确认明日安装、起草 4,200 美元厨房拆除发票，或显示未付余额超过 10,000 美元的工作。每项操作都会使用您现有权限，直接在实时 PracticPro 账户中执行。执行操作前请确认。

payload.name: Talonic
payload.description: 提取数据并与文档对话
payload.summaryOriginal: Extract data and talk to docs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Talonic helps users turn documents such as PDFs, scans, invoices, contracts, certificates, statements, and forms into schema-validated JSON. 
Users can extract structured fields, convert documents to markdown, search and filter their Talonic workspace, manage reusable extraction schemas, check document status, request browser upload links, and view credit balance information.
payload.longDescription:
Talonic 帮助用户将 PDF、扫描件、发票、合同、证书、对账单和表单等文档转换为经过架构验证的 JSON。
用户可以提取结构化字段、将文档转换为 Markdown、搜索和筛选 Talonic 工作区、管理可重复使用的提取架构、查看文档状态、请求浏览器上传链接，并查看额度余额信息。

payload.name: tugesto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: tugesto es el asistente para evolucionar la gestión de tu empresa: nóminas, RRHH, registro horario, portal del empleado, facturación, contabilidad, fiscalidad y cumplimiento legal en un mismo entorno. Desde ChatGPT, te ayuda a resolver dudas, entender procesos y descubrir cómo automatizar tareas, reducir errores y centralizar la operativa diaria con una solución SaaS pensada para empresas, autónomos, gestorías y asesorías.
payload.longDescription: tugesto 是一款帮助企业升级管理方式的助手：在同一环境中处理薪资、人力资源、工时记录、员工门户、开票、会计、税务和法律合规。通过 ChatGPT，它能帮助你解答疑问、理解流程，并了解如何借助面向企业、自雇人士、会计事务所和咨询机构的 SaaS 解决方案实现任务自动化、减少错误并集中管理日常运营。

payload.name: Cinch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cinch helps users work with their project management data in ChatGPT by listing companies and projects, inspecting tasks and comments, creating project work, updating task fields, and adding task comments.
payload.longDescription: Cinch 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中处理项目管理数据，包括列出公司和项目、查看任务与评论、创建项目工作、更新任务字段以及添加任务评论。

payload.name: Socra Cortex
payload.description: 别再对 AI 重复说明
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Socra Cortex helps people and teams stop repeating the same preferences, requirements, and decisions to ChatGPT and Codex. It keeps that knowledge and its reasons in a single source of truth that agents can retrieve before acting, across conversations and tools.

Modules record what should be and why, with a responsible owner and version history. Dependencies link the knowledge required to understand it. Flash loads the relevant Module and all its Dependencies, foundations first and each Module once.

Team members can own different subjects while their knowledge works together. For example, a product requirement Module created in ChatGPT can depend on architecture and security Modules maintained by their owners. Codex can Flash that requirement before implementing it and receive those decisions together.

As conversations and work reveal new knowledge, agents propose changes to existing Modules, so the knowledge always stays up to date. The suggested workflow asks them to show exact Before and After content and Dependencies for the owner's approval before saving. Updates become available on later Flashes, while version history preserves earlier knowledge and records changes.

Issues connect tasks to the Modules governing them, with assignees, work dependencies, comments, and evidence. Inboxes show unblocked work to its responsible person or agent; completed Issues preserve the outcome and history.

People and teams own the knowledge in their Socra Account, with Module permissions for people and groups. Review Modules, the knowledge map, and work at https://cortex.socra.com. Connect ChatGPT, Codex, or any other AI provider to that same Account with Cortex access.

Setup and agent instructions: https://workspace.socra.com/docs/cortex/installation.md
payload.longDescription:
Socra Cortex 帮助个人和团队不必一遍遍向 ChatGPT 和 Codex 重复相同的偏好、要求和决策。它将这些知识及其原因保存在统一的事实来源中，供智能体在不同对话和工具中采取行动前检索。

Modules 记录应该做什么以及原因，并包含责任人和版本历史。Dependencies 用于关联理解这些知识所必需的信息。Flash 会先加载基础内容，再加载相关 Module 及其全部 Dependencies，每个 Module 只加载一次。

团队成员可以分别负责不同主题，同时让各自的知识协同工作。例如，在 ChatGPT 中创建的产品需求 Module 可以依赖由相应负责人维护的架构和安全 Modules。Codex 在实施该需求前可以 Flash 它，并一并获得这些决策。

随着对话和工作产生新知识，智能体会提议修改现有 Modules，让知识始终保持最新。建议的工作流程会要求它们在保存前展示精确的修改前后内容和 Dependencies，供负责人审批。更新会在后续 Flash 时生效，而版本历史会保留早期知识并记录变更。

Issues 将任务与其所依据的 Modules 关联起来，并包含受指派人、工作依赖、评论和证据。收件箱会向相应负责人或智能体显示没有阻塞的工作；已完成的 Issues 会保留结果和历史记录。

个人和团队在自己的 Socra Account 中拥有这些知识，并可为人员和群组设置 Module 权限。请访问 https://cortex.socra.com. 查看 Modules、知识地图和工作情况。你可以将 ChatGPT、Codex 或任何其他 AI 服务商连接到具有 Cortex 访问权限的同一 Account。

设置和智能体说明：https://workspace.socra.com/docs/cortex/installation.md

payload.name: Curaiz Remote Jobs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find fresh remote jobs matched to your experience, goals, and eligible locations. Describe the work you want and where you can legally work; Curaiz searches current remote postings and returns the strongest candidates with role, company, applicant locations, salary when stated, and a direct listing link. Ask for full details to review requirements, company context, and the application URL. Curaiz is read-only and never applies, sends messages, or changes data on your behalf.
payload.longDescription: 根据你的经验、目标和符合条件的工作地点，查找最新的远程职位。描述你想做的工作以及你在法律上可以工作的地点；Curaiz 会搜索当前远程职位，并返回最匹配的机会，包括职位、公司、允许申请者所在地点、已注明的薪资和职位直达链接。你可以询问完整详情，以查看要求、公司背景和申请网址。Curaiz 仅提供只读功能，绝不会代你申请、发送消息或更改数据。

payload.name: Namp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Namp MCP helps authenticated users find projects, notes, memos, meeting minutes, boards, members, and files, plus create or update private project workspace content and upload project files through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Namp MCP 帮助已通过身份验证的用户查找项目、笔记、备忘录、会议纪要、看板、成员和文件；还可以通过 ChatGPT 创建或更新私人项目工作区内容，以及上传项目文件。

payload.name: JobLoop
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect JobLoop to ChatGPT to manage your job search faster. Search your saved applications, add confirmed jobs, create tailored resume versions, save STAR stories, and log interview debriefs directly in your JobLoop workspace.
payload.longDescription: 将 JobLoop 连接到 ChatGPT，更高效地管理求职流程。在 JobLoop 工作区中搜索已保存的申请、添加已确认的职位、创建定制简历版本、保存 STAR 经历，并记录面试复盘。

payload.name: Jibble
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jibble is the highest-rated time tracking and attendance software according to independent user reviews. With free-forever time tracking for unlimited users, teams can track hours, attendance, projects, time off, and more.

Connect Jibble to ChatGPT and turn your workforce data into instant answers, insights, and actions. Ask how many hours your team worked, where time is being spent, who's working overtime, how attendance is trending, or how many hours have been logged to a project. ChatGPT can analyze your Jibble data, summarize findings, compare results, and surface useful patterns — without having to dig through reports.

You can also take action directly from the conversation: clock in or out, correct missed punches, manage time off, and generate reports.

Whether you're checking a single person's hours or looking for broader workforce trends, Jibble + ChatGPT gives you a faster way to ask questions, understand your data, and get things done.
payload.longDescription:
根据独立用户评价，Jibble 是评分最高的工时追踪和出勤软件。它永久免费为不限数量的用户提供工时追踪，团队可追踪工时、出勤、项目、休假等信息。

将 Jibble 连接到 ChatGPT，即可把员工数据转化为即时答案、洞察和操作。你可以询问团队工作了多少小时、时间花在哪里、谁在加班、出勤趋势如何，或某个项目记录了多少工时。ChatGPT 可以分析你的 Jibble 数据、总结发现、比较结果并找出有用规律，无需翻查报告。

你还可以直接在对话中执行操作：上下班打卡、更正漏打卡记录、管理员工休假并生成报告。

无论你是查看某个人的工时，还是了解更广泛的员工趋势，Jibble + ChatGPT 都能让你更快地提问、理解数据并完成工作。

payload.name: Softr
payload.description: 面向企业的AI应用构建器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Softr is an AI app builder that turns your data into apps, portals, and automations. This connector gives ChatGPT direct access to your Softr workspace, so you can go from an idea to a working, published app in a single conversation.

Databases: create tables and the fields to match your project, structure and import records, and browse data sources you have already connected.

Applications: generate an app on top of your data, add and arrange pages and blocks, configure sign-up and login, set user groups and page permissions, and manage app users. Extend any page with a custom code block that ChatGPT writes for you, with every version saved so you can roll back.

Workflows: build multi-step automations with triggers, actions, and branching logic, test each step against real data, and publish when it works.

ChatGPT can preview the result and, when you ask it to, publish live. Everything it makes appears in Softr Studio exactly like work done by hand, so you and your team keep editing in the visual builder afterward - nothing is locked into the chat.

Day to day, ChatGPT can also work with your data directly: search, filter, and aggregate records, and create or update them in bulk.

Every action runs with your own permissions, and you choose the access level per workspace when you connect: read-only, edit, or full access.
payload.longDescription:
Softr是一个AI应用构建器，可将您的数据转化为应用、门户和自动化流程。此连接器让ChatGPT可以直接访问您的Softr工作区，因此您可以通过一次对话从创意快速构建并发布应用。

数据库：创建与项目匹配的表格及字段，构建数据结构并导入记录，浏览已连接的数据源。

应用：基于数据生成应用，添加并排列页面和模块，配置注册与登录功能，设置用户组和页面权限，管理应用用户。通过ChatGPT为您编写的自定义代码模块扩展任意页面，所有版本都会被保存以便回滚。

工作流：通过触发器、操作和分支逻辑构建多步骤自动化流程，使用真实数据测试每个步骤，确认无误后即可发布。

ChatGPT可预览结果，并在您要求时直接发布上线。它生成的所有内容在Softr Studio中呈现效果与人工操作完全一致，您和团队后续仍可继续在可视化编辑器中修改——聊天中的内容不会被锁定。

日常使用中，ChatGPT还可直接操作您的数据：搜索、筛选和聚合记录，并批量创建或更新数据。

每项操作均以您的权限执行，您可在连接时选择工作区的访问级别：只读、编辑或完全访问。

payload.name: Sydium
payload.description: 用自己的风格安排帖子
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sydium for ChatGPT connects your existing Sydium workspace - it requires an active plan or trial, and connecting doesn't start one (plans are managed at sydium.com). Once connected, ChatGPT can draft captions the way you actually write (learned from what you have already published), schedule or publish to up to ten platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Mastodon), check how posts performed, pull today's content idea, and manage the upcoming queue - edit, reschedule, or cancel anything still scheduled. Agencies can act for individual clients with the same team-scoped permissions as the Sydium app. Publishing actions are explicit: ChatGPT confirms before anything lands on a public feed.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 版 Sydium 可连接你现有的 Sydium 工作区——使用需要有效订阅方案或试用期，连接本身不会自动开通方案（方案由 sydium.com 管理）。连接后，ChatGPT 可以按照你一贯的写作风格起草文案（根据你已发布的内容学习），安排或发布到最多十个平台（Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、LinkedIn、X、Facebook、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Mastodon），查看帖子表现、获取今日内容灵感，并管理即将发布的队列——编辑、重新安排或取消仍处于排期中的内容。代理机构可以代表各个客户执行操作，权限范围与 Sydium 应用中的团队权限一致。发布操作需要明确确认：ChatGPT 会在内容发布到公开动态前征求确认。

payload.name: Clio
payload.description: 在 Clio 中访问 Vincent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Vincent’s legal intelligence into Codex. Research the law, analyze dockets and develop case strategy with access to Clio Library and Clio Docket, with citations back to the underlying sources. Your matters and firm data stay securely governed in Clio.
payload.longDescription: 将 Vincent 的法律智能引入 Codex。借助 Clio Library 和 Clio Docket 研究法律、分析案卷并制定案件策略，同时获得指向底层来源的引文。你的案件和律所数据仍由 Clio 安全管理。

payload.name: Discipline Rewards (D/R)
payload.description: 随处规划，在 D/R 中执行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Want to build better habits, stay consistent with goals, improve your health, strengthen your routines, or create a plan for personal growth? ChatGPT can help you brainstorm ideas, structure goals, build habit systems, and create accountability plans tailored to what you're trying to achieve.

When you're ready, ChatGPT can send that plan to Discipline Rewards as a pending draft for review. Nothing is added automatically. Every plan must be reviewed and approved inside Discipline Rewards before habits, goals, or accountability commitments are created.

Discipline Rewards helps turn good intentions into consistent action. Use ChatGPT to think through the plan, then use Discipline Rewards to review, approve, and execute it.

This integration is designed to keep planning flexible while keeping execution intentional. Build plans in ChatGPT, then follow through in Discipline Rewards.
payload.longDescription:
想养成更好的习惯、坚持目标、改善健康、加强日常规律，或制定个人成长计划？ChatGPT 可以帮你构思想法、梳理目标、建立习惯体系，并根据你的目标制定问责计划。

准备好后，ChatGPT 可以将计划发送到 Discipline Rewards，作为待审核草稿。内容不会自动添加。必须在 Discipline Rewards 中审查并批准每项计划，之后才会创建习惯、目标或问责承诺。

Discipline Rewards 帮助你将良好意愿转化为持续行动。先用 ChatGPT 梳理计划，再用 Discipline Rewards 审核、批准并执行。

此集成旨在让规划保持灵活，同时确保执行经过慎重确认。在 ChatGPT 中制定计划，再通过 Discipline Rewards 跟进落实。

payload.name: ArtifactBridge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ArtifactBridge connects ChatGPT to your team's document workspace. Search and read stored documents, create managed documents, discuss changes, and submit proposals for review. Governed document changes require an authorized human review; owners can update working documents directly when review is not required. You can also organize documents, coordinate work in Agent Rooms, and publish a version through a share link. Depending on your workspace configuration, comments may be mirrored to Google Docs or Notion, proposals may notify Slack, and activity events may be delivered to external webhooks. Access and review permissions still apply. Requires an ArtifactBridge account.

payload.name: GPS-Ortung24

payload.name: NextClip

payload.name: Sive.Host Domain Finder

payload.name: TracX Logis
payload.description: 追踪货件并预订全球运输
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Effortless Global Shipping and Tracking with TX Logis

- Personal and Business Shipping: Support for both individual customers and business users sending parcels or managing shipments.

Simplify your international logistics, parcel delivery, booking, and tracking experience with the TX Logis assistant.
payload.longDescription:
通过 TX Logis 轻松完成全球运输与追踪

TX Logis 是一款全球物流和包裹配送助手，帮助用户轻松使用国际运输服务。

无论你是要寄送个人包裹到海外、预约取件、提交运输申请，还是追踪企业货件，TX Logis 都会分步骤提供顺畅可靠的配送支持。

TX Logis 支持需要物流服务、包裹配送、快递服务、运输预订、货件申请、个人寄件、快速配送、国际运输和货件追踪的用户。

payload.longDescription: Hydrosight 将土壤传感器连接到 ChatGPT，让你通过简单提问查看实时和历史土壤湿度、温度及盐度数据，了解天气状况和预报，并据此做出更好的灌溉决策。

payload.name: Clean Harbors Careers

payload.name: Transcriptor
payload.description: 查看视频转录文本和元数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Transcriptor lets ChatGPT work with video the way it works with text. Paste a link from YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Twitch, Vimeo, Facebook, Bilibili, VK, Dailymotion or Reddit and ask for a summary, a quote with its timestamp, the chapter list, the publisher and view counts, or the still frame at a given timecode. Four of them render interactive widgets in the chat: a search carousel, a searchable timed transcript, a metadata card, and a frame viewer. The service retrieves only public captions, metadata, thumbnails and single still frames; it never returns or redistributes video or audio files.
payload.longDescription: Transcriptor 让 ChatGPT 像处理文本一样处理视频。粘贴 YouTube、Twitter/X、Instagram、TikTok、Twitch、Vimeo、Facebook、Bilibili、VK、Dailymotion 或 Reddit 链接，然后要求生成摘要、带时间戳的引述、章节列表、发布者和观看次数，或指定时间码的静帧。8 个只读工具覆盖整个流程：支持长视频游标分页的清理后纯文本转录、原始 SRT/VTT 字幕、可用字幕语言列表、扩展元数据、章节标记、任意时间码的单帧、所选播放列表项目的批量转录，以及 YouTube 搜索。其中 4 个工具会在聊天中生成交互式组件：搜索轮播、可搜索的定时转录文本、元数据卡片和画面查看器。该服务仅获取公开字幕、元数据、缩略图和单张静帧；绝不返回或重新分发视频或音频文件。

payload.name: Pocket Bartender

payload.name: Esment
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Esment gives ChatGPT persistent, inspectable memory for facts, preferences, decisions, and project context. It can recall relevant context, save durable information, update or forget memories, and read organized pages (created locally, not yet available in the cloud) and memory blocks belonging to the authenticated user.
payload.longDescription: Esment 为 ChatGPT 提供可检查的持久记忆，用于保存事实、偏好、决策和项目背景。它可以回忆相关上下文、保存长期有用的信息、更新或遗忘记忆，并读取属于已认证用户的整理页面（在本地创建，尚未提供云端版本）和记忆区块。

payload.name: Evernote
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Evernote MCP server connects your Evernote account to your AI tools, so they can work from the notes, documents, and files you've already collected. Search across years of captured material, edit and organize what's there, and file new work straight back into your notebooks.

Key features:
• Search by keyword or by meaning - Use Evernote's search grammar to filter by notebook, tag, and date, or search semantically to surface notes by what they're about, even when you can't remember the words you used.
• Find what you never typed - Search reaches text inside scanned documents, photos, and images, and inside transcribed audio and video — so handwritten pages, whiteboard shots, receipts, and recorded meetings are all searchable alongside your written notes. Attached files can be downloaded and new ones uploaded.
• Read, write, and edit real notes - Fetch a note's full content, tags, and attachments; create new notes in the right notebook; update titles and bodies; and restore anything that ends up in the trash.
• Keep your account organized - Move notes between notebooks, add and remove tags, rename and re-parent tags, and create notebooks and Spaces as your work grows.
• Manage tasks inside your notes - Create tasks, update status and due dates, and find the ones you own or have been assigned, filtered by priority.
Everything happens inside your own account, under your existing permissions.
payload.longDescription:
Evernote MCP 服务器将你的 Evernote 账户连接到 AI 工具，让它们可以利用你已收集的笔记、文档和文件。搜索多年积累的资料、编辑和整理现有内容，并将新成果直接存入笔记本。

主要功能：
• 按关键词或含义搜索——使用 Evernote 搜索语法按笔记本、标签和日期筛选，也可进行语义搜索；即使记不起用过哪些词，也能按内容主题找到笔记。
• 搜索你从未打过的文字——搜索范围包括扫描文档、照片和图像中的文字，以及音视频转录内容，因此手写页面、白板照片、收据和录制的会议都能与文字笔记一并搜索。附件可下载，也可上传新附件。
• 读取、撰写和编辑真实笔记——获取笔记全文、标签和附件；在合适的笔记本中新建笔记；更新标题和正文；并恢复误入废纸篓的内容。
• 整理账户——在笔记本间移动笔记、添加或移除标签、重命名标签并调整标签层级，还可随工作发展创建笔记本和 Spaces。
• 管理笔记中的任务——创建任务、更新状态和截止日期，并按优先级查找自己拥有或被分配的任务。
所有操作都在你自己的账户中进行，并遵循你现有的权限。

payload.name: TEAM 30 — AI Company OS
payload.description: 通过 31 个 AI 角色规划工作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TEAM 30 routes a goal to the right specialist role, turns projects into scope-locked plans, and identifies actions that need explicit approval. The first public version is read-only: it does not send messages, spend money, delete data, publish content, or connect private accounts.
payload.longDescription: TEAM 30 会将目标分配给合适的专业角色，把项目转化为范围明确的计划，并识别需要明确批准的操作。首个公开版本为只读：不会发送消息、花费资金、删除数据、发布内容或连接私人账户。

payload.name: Support Ticket Validator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Support Ticket Validator checks whether support ticket data contains the required fields before human processing or handoff. It returns a structured completeness result with checked fields, present fields, missing fields, and validation errors, helping support teams identify incomplete ticket information without modifying external systems.
payload.longDescription: Support Ticket Validator 会在人工作业或交接前，检查支持工单数据是否包含所需的必填字段。它返回结构化的完整性检查结果，包括已检查字段、已提供字段、缺失字段及验证错误，帮助支持团队识别不完整的工单信息，同时不修改外部系统。

payload.name: Giraffe
payload.description: 让 AI 项目保持清晰
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Giraffe keeps your AI projects clear and current across ChatGPT and other compatible AI assistants. Save and retrieve project context, decisions, facts, notes, open questions, and documents from whichever AI tool you are using.

When plans change, Giraffe helps preserve the latest agreed state, what changed, and which earlier information was replaced—so you can continue working without searching through old chats or rebuilding context.

Use Giraffe to organize Spaces and Projects, search your knowledge, and create or update Documents directly from your AI assistant. Giraffe is free to use.
payload.longDescription:
Giraffe 可在 ChatGPT 及其他兼容的 AI 助手中，帮助你保持 AI 项目清晰且信息最新。无论你使用哪种 AI 工具，都可以保存和检索项目上下文、决策、事实、笔记、待解决问题和文档。

计划发生变化时，Giraffe 会帮助保留最新达成的一致状态、记录变更内容以及标记被替代的旧信息，让你无需翻找旧聊天或重建上下文即可继续工作。

通过 AI 助手使用 Giraffe 整理 Spaces 和 Projects、搜索知识，并直接创建或更新文档。Giraffe 可免费使用。

payload.name: Jamie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your meetings into ChatGPT. Ask about your work, draw on conversation context, and get work done.
payload.longDescription: 将你的会议带入 ChatGPT。询问工作相关问题，利用对话上下文，高效完成工作。

payload.name: Signeasy

payload.longDescription: HWPXkit 可从链接或附件打开 HWPX 文件，列出可编辑的单元格、段落、LaTeX 公式和行，然后填写表单空白处，或应用文本、文本片段格式和行编辑。它会返回可下载的编辑副本，并支持一步撤销；源文件不会被更改。

payload.name: Supermemory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Supermemory builds your personal or company context and makes it interoperable between all providers. Use it to create a shared company brain that you can use with any AI agent with a team, or for personal use.
payload.longDescription: Supermemory可为你构建个人或企业上下文，并实现跨所有提供者的互操作性。可用于打造共享的公司大脑，可与任何AI代理配合使用，适用于团队或个人场景。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

Plan and schedule
Draft a post, choose which of your connected accounts it goes to, attach an image or video, and place it on the calendar for a specific time. Save it as a draft, route it for approval, or approve one that is already waiting. Review what is queued and remove a scheduled post. Supported accounts: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Telegram, and Google Business Profile.

Check how posts did
Look up the performance of a published post, or how an account's follower count has moved day by day. Analytics cover Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest Business accounts, and LinkedIn company pages.

Add an account
Generate a link that opens PostFast's account connection flow when you want to add a new social profile.

How it works
PostFast connects to each social network under its own app registrations and platform credentials, and stores your drafts, scheduled posts, media and comment history in your own PostFast workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Some tools do call a platform live, for example when publishing a post, and each of those is labelled as such.

You sign in with your existing PostFast account over OAuth. Viewing accounts, writing posts, and reading analytics are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time. The connector also exposes comment management tools used by other clients, which are not part of the workflows described here.

payload.name: AI Detector by AI GPT Zero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check essays, research papers, articles, and professional documents for signs of AI-generated writing inside ChatGPT. This AI detector and AI checker analyzes text you provide and returns AI and human likelihood scores, sentence-level highlights, and review guidance. The interactive workspace keeps your original text and detection results together for a clear, focused review.

Use it as a ChatGPT detector when reviewing text that may contain AI-generated writing, an AI essay checker for academic manuscripts, or an AI content detector for editorial and business documents. The tool supports AI writing review by bringing overall scores and individual sentence highlights into the same view, helping you identify passages that deserve closer attention.

Paste text into the workspace, run an AI detection scan, and read the overall assessment. Inspect highlighted sentences, consider the review guidance, and compare the results with the surrounding paragraphs. This text-checking workflow helps you move from a general question about possible AI use to a closer examination of specific passages.

Educators and researchers can use the AI text detector to support the review of essays, assignments, research papers, literature reviews, and other academic writing. Consider the findings alongside drafts, citations, source material, assignment requirements, and discussion with the author. Sentence-level AI detection provides an additional reference for understanding the text within its academic context.

Editors, publishers, journalists, and content teams can examine contributed articles, blog posts, newsletters, opinion pieces, and editorial drafts for possible AI-generated content. Use the AI content checker during an editorial review to identify sections that warrant follow-up with the writer and to keep the discussion grounded in the supplied text.

Marketing and SEO teams can review website copy, landing-page text, product descriptions, campaign content, and client deliverables. Business teams can check reports, proposals, and other professional writing. The same AI writing detector workflow helps reviewers examine the text they receive and decide where additional context or author input would be useful.

Whether you need an AI text checker for a research manuscript, a GPT detector for an article, or AI-generated text detection for business content, the workspace combines an overall assessment with sentence-level detail. Review possible AI writing, inspect the highlighted passages, and use the results to guide a more informed conversation about the content.

Detection results are estimates and should be interpreted with context and human judgment.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中检查论文、研究报告、文章和专业文档是否存在AI生成写作的迹象。这款AI检测工具会分析你提供的文本，返回AI及人类写作的可能性评分、句子级高亮和审阅建议。交互式工作区将原文和检测结果放在一起，便于清晰、专注地审阅。

审阅可能含有AI生成内容的文本时，可将其用作 ChatGPT 检测工具；检查学术文稿时，可用作AI论文检测工具；检查编辑及商业文档时，可用作AI内容检测工具。它将总体评分和各句高亮汇集在同一视图中，支持AI写作审阅，帮助你识别需要进一步关注的段落。

将文本粘贴到工作区，运行AI检测扫描，并阅读总体评估。检查高亮句子、考虑审阅建议，并结合周围段落比较结果。这一文本检查流程帮助你从是否可能使用AI的一般性问题，深入到具体段落的细致检查。

教育工作者和研究人员可使用AI文本检测工具辅助审阅论文、作业、研究报告、文献综述和其他学术写作。应结合草稿、引用、源材料、作业要求及与作者的沟通来考虑检测结果。句子级AI检测为在学术语境中理解文本提供额外参考。

编辑、出版商、记者和内容团队可检查投稿文章、博客文章、新闻简报、评论文章和编辑稿件中是否可能含有AI生成内容。在编辑审阅中使用AI内容检测工具，识别需要向作者进一步核实的部分，并让讨论以所提供的文本为依据。

营销和SEO团队可审阅网站文案、落地页文本、产品描述、营销活动内容和客户交付成果。业务团队可检查报告、提案和其他专业写作。同样的AI写作检测流程帮助审阅人员检查收到的文本，判断哪些地方需要更多背景信息或作者说明。

无论你需要研究文稿的AI文本检测、文章的GPT检测，还是商业内容的AI生成文本检测，工作区都将总体评估与句子级细节结合起来。审阅可能由AI撰写的内容、检查高亮段落，并利用结果引导更有依据的内容讨论。

检测结果属于估计，应结合上下文和人的判断进行解读。

payload.name: Page2AI
payload.description: 将公开网页转换为 Markdown
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Page2AI converts a single public web page — only the URL you explicitly provide — into clean Markdown for LLM context: main content extracted, boilerplate dropped, headings, code blocks, tables and links preserved, optional YAML frontmatter with the source URL and title. On-demand and read-only: no crawling, no accounts, no data stored by the application. It does not bypass paywalls, logins, rate limits or any site's access controls; private-network and cloud-metadata URLs are refused; responses are capped at 10 MB with enforced timeouts and per-IP rate limits. The identical MIT-licensed engine is available as a local MCP server (npx -y page2ai-mcp) for fully private workflows.
payload.longDescription: Page2AI 会将单个公开网页（仅限你明确提供的 URL）转换为适合大型语言模型上下文的整洁 Markdown：提取主要内容并去除模板杂项，同时保留标题、代码块、表格和链接；还可选择添加包含来源 URL 和标题的 YAML 前置元数据。按需运行且只读：不会爬取网页、不需要账户，也不会由应用存储数据。它不会绕过付费墙、登录、速率限制或任何网站的访问控制；会拒绝私有网络和云元数据 URL；响应上限为 10 MB，并强制实施超时和按 IP 限速。相同的 MIT 许可引擎也可作为本地 MCP 服务器使用（npx -y page2ai-mcp），适用于完全私密的工作流。

payload.name: Deep Document Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Deep Document Search turns ChatGPT into a powerful interface for your private document knowledge base. Search and analyze PDFs, Word files, scanned documents, and large document collections using natural language; find relevant information across thousands or millions of files; and get accurate, traceable answers with citations back to the original documents. It is built for document-intensive workflows such as legal research, regulatory compliance, corporate knowledge, due diligence, research, and document analysis.
payload.longDescription: Deep Document Search 将 ChatGPT 转变为私有文档知识库的强大界面。使用自然语言搜索和分析 PDF、Word 文件、扫描文档及大型文档集合；从数千或数百万份文件中查找相关信息；并获取准确、可追溯且引用原始文档的答案。适用于法律研究、法规合规、企业知识管理、尽职调查、研究和文档分析等文档密集型工作流。

payload.name: gradireland
payload.description: 在爱尔兰寻找毕业生职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find your graduate jobs, internships or placements across Ireland, directly in ChatGPT. Search by role, location or sector, check requirements and deadlines, and explore opportunities from leading employers. When you’re ready, open the full listing on gradireland to apply. Plus, discover career events, tools and advice built for students and recent graduates.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中查找爱尔兰各地的毕业生职位、实习或实习安排。按职位、地点或行业搜索，查看要求和截止日期，并探索知名雇主提供的机会。准备好申请时，可在 gradireland 上打开完整职位信息并提交申请。此外还可发现面向学生和应届毕业生的职业活动、工具和建议。

payload.name: Coverlttr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coverlttr helps users create job-targeted cover letters from their uploaded CV and a job description. Through ChatGPT, users can check their credit balance, browse saved job listings, estimate generation cost, create or regenerate a letter, apply a professional LaTeX template (PDF), and export the final document — all without leaving the conversation.
payload.longDescription: Coverlttr 根据用户上传的简历和职位描述，帮助创建针对具体职位的求职信。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以查看积分余额、浏览已保存的职位信息、估算生成费用、创建或重新生成求职信、应用专业 LaTeX 模板（PDF），并导出最终文档——全程无需离开对话。

payload.name: SEO&OH AI
payload.description: 查找录音的转写、摘要和思维导图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 서앤오AI 녹음 앱에 저장된 녹음을 ChatGPT에서 바로 찾아보세요. 녹음 목록과 상세 정보, 전체 전사본, AI 요약, 마인드맵을 불러올 수 있습니다. 로그인한 본인 계정의 데이터만 읽어오며, 어떤 데이터도 수정하거나 삭제하지 않는 읽기 전용 도구입니다. 회의·인터뷰·강의 녹음을 검색하고 핵심만 빠르게 확인하는 데 유용합니다.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中直接查找保存在 서앤오AI 录音应用里的录音。你可以调取录音列表和详情、完整转写文本、AI 摘要及思维导图。它只读取已登录账户本人的数据，不会修改或删除任何数据，是一款只读工具。适合搜索会议、访谈和课程录音，并快速了解重点。

payload.name: Proposal.Biz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create professional, beautifully designed business documents from a single prompt in under 60 seconds. Just describe what you need and let AI do the rest.
payload.longDescription: 在60秒内通过单个提示生成专业且精美设计的商业文档。只需描述您的需求，其余交给AI完成。

payload.name: Mintlify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Mintlify to Claude to keep your documentation accurate and up to date without leaving your conversations. Claude can search across every page, read and edit content directly, and ship changes. Perfect for fixing outdated pages after a product change, reorganizing sections as your product grows, or drafting new content alongside the code it documents.
payload.longDescription: 将Mintlify连接到Claude，即可在不离开对话的情况下保持文档准确且及时更新。Claude可以跨每一页搜索、直接阅读和编辑内容，并发布更改。适用于在产品更新后修复过时页面、随着产品增长重新组织部分，或在编写代码文档时同步起草新内容。

payload.name: Devpost Hackathons
payload.description: 查找并报名参加黑客马拉松
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: From Devpost, the leading hackathon platform. Find hackathons, register, build, and submit, all without leaving ChatGPT. An optional build assistant walks you through ideation, scoping, and planning to help you ship a strong project.
payload.longDescription: 来自领先的黑客马拉松平台 Devpost。在 ChatGPT 中即可查找黑客马拉松、注册、开发并提交项目，无需离开对话。可选的开发助手会引导你构思创意、确定范围并制定计划，帮助你交付出色项目。

payload.name: Adalo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and manage no-code apps entirely through conversation.  Adalo's ChatGPT integration lets you create, modify, and   manage mobile and web applications without ever leaving the    chat. Just describe what you want — Adalo's AI builds it   for you.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话完全构建和管理无代码应用。
Adalo的ChatGPT集成让您无需离开聊天界面即可创建、修改和管理移动及网页应用。
只需描述您的需求——Adalo的AI将为您自动构建。

payload.name: Agiflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Agiflow is a shared project board for turning plans into trackable work. Create projects, break them into work units and tasks, set priorities and statuses, assign work, add comments and attachments, and review progress across your workspace. Use Agiflow to plan launches, organize backlogs, run standups, triage incoming work, and keep decisions connected to the tasks they affect. Changes are saved to your authenticated Agiflow workspace, where your team can review and continue the work.
payload.longDescription: Agiflow 是共享项目看板，用于将计划转为可跟踪的工作。创建项目，将其拆分为工作单元和任务，设置优先级和状态，分配工作，添加评论及附件，并查看整个工作区的进度。使用 Agiflow 规划发布、整理待办事项、开展站会、分流新工作，并将决策与其影响的任务关联。修改会保存到你已登录的 Agiflow 工作区，团队可在那里审阅并继续开展工作。

payload.name: Graffiticode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Graffiticode is a platform of specialized agents, each purpose-built for one kind of task and each producing a real, editable artifact rather than text in a chat window.

Today's agents create interactive quizzes and assessment items — multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank, hot text, sequencing and matching — plus flashcard decks, spreadsheets and budgets, charts, and concept maps. Describe what you want in plain English; the matching agent validates your request against a formal task language and returns a structured result you can refine, re-render, and keep.

For teams working in Learnosity, Graffiticode also authors Learnosity-compatible assessment items and writes integration recipes for the Author API and the Data API — embedding an item authoring UX, or reading and writing an item bank server to server. New agents are added to the catalog over time.
payload.longDescription:
Graffiticode是一个专业代理平台，每个代理都针对特定任务进行定制，能够生成可编辑的实体文件，而非聊天窗口中的文本。

当前的代理可创建交互式测验和评估题——包括单选题、填空题、热点文本、排序题和匹配题——以及闪卡组、电子表格和预算表、图表和概念图。
用日常英语描述你的需求；匹配的代理会将请求与正式任务语言进行验证，并返回可优化、重渲染并保存的结构化结果。

对于使用Learnosity的团队，Graffiticode还可创建兼容Learnosity的评估题，并为Author API和Data API编写集成方案——嵌入题目创作用户界面，或实现项目库服务器间的读写操作。
新代理会随时间推移逐步加入目录。
